title: The 4 Best Dog Crates Under $80
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for dog crates under $80, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dog crates under $80 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: MidWest iCrate 36-Inch Double Door Dog Crate
products.blurb: Key specs: Typically $55 to $65, Included divider panel, Double door, leak-proof tray.
strengths: Includes the divider panel most budget competitors charge extra for
Double door design usually costs more on other budget crates
limitations: Standard wire gauge, not for determined chewers
Plastic tray is durable but not indestructible over years of use

products.name: SportPet Designs Sport Pet Large Portable Kennel
products.blurb: Key specs: Typically $65 to $80, Lightweight folding wire construction, Carrying handle.
strengths: Cheapest genuinely portable option in this price range
Lightweight design suits buyers who move the crate often
Quick setup and fold for occasional travel use
limitations: Lighter wire gauge than the MidWest, best for calm and smaller dogs
Fewer size options than the iCrate lineup

products.name: MidWest LifeStages 24-Inch Double Door Dog Crate
strengths: Folds flat with a carry handle
limitations: Some dogs learn to push the pan
